summary: This note is a short encyclopedia-style entry on Champlain, a municipality in Quebec, Canada. It states that Champlain lies within Les Chenaux Regional County Municipality and the Mauricie administrative region. It also notes that the town sits on the north shore of the St. Lawrence River and forms part of the Trois-Rivières metropolitan area.
one_line: Champlain is a municipality in the Mauricie region of Quebec, Canada, on the St. Lawrence River's north shore near Trois-Rivières.
key_facts: Champlain is a municipality in the province of Quebec, Canada.
Champlain is located in Les Chenaux Regional County Municipality.
Champlain is located in the administrative region the Mauricie.
Champlain is located on the north shore of the St. Lawrence River.
Champlain is part of the metropolitan area of Trois-Rivières.
